message: 22 October recovery found daily research automations disabled and no normal reports for 19–21 October. GitHub Pages workflow only validates/deploys static content. Strict gates unchanged; source execution coverage remains PARTIAL and must be evidenced per source on every run.

Configured source universe is not treated as executed unless run evidence exists.
